papers.title_en: Distributionally Robust Chance-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Home Energy Management under Electric Vehicle Uncertainty
papers.authors: Meng Yuan, Ye Wang, Yi Mei, Ramesh Rayudu, Alan Brent, Xinghuo Yu, Mengjie Zhang
papers.evidence: 分布鲁棒机会约束强化学习与收紧的安全约束
papers.tldr: 住宅电气化与电动汽车普及带来需求侧灵活性，但随机驾驶行为使离车可用性与热舒适难以保障。本文将家庭调度建模为分布鲁棒机会约束马尔可夫决策过程，用2-Wasserstein模糊集应对EV行为尾风险与分布偏移，并以拉格朗日软演员-评论家结合在线边界保护求解。惠灵顿一年退化预测测试中，该控制器满足每日EV目标和两项机会约束，年成本较规则基线降8.6%、舒适违规小时降69%，为EV不确定下家庭能量管理提供可靠调度。
papers.abstract_en: The electrification of residential energy systems and adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) create demand-side flexibility. However, random driving behaviour makes it difficult to ensure EV readiness at departure and maintain thermal comfort. To address this, we formulate residential scheduling as a distributionally robust (DR) chance-constrained Markov decision process, whose 2-Wasserstein ambiguity set guards against tail risk and distribution shift in EV behaviour. The intractable DR chance constraint is then replaced by a sufficient tightened expectation constraint under the nominal distribution. The resulting problem is solved by a Lagrangian soft actor--critic with distributional cost critics, and an online boundary guard enforces EV reachability and thermal comfort within the actuator limits at every step. Five controllers are compared over one year in Wellington, New Zealand, under a degraded forecast. The proposed controller is the cheapest controller that meets the EV target on every day and both chance constraints under forecast error and random driving behaviour. Compared with the rule-based baseline, the only other controller to do so, it lowers the annual cost by 8.6% and the comfort violation hours by 69%. The ablation study confirms that the boundary guard ensures pointwise feasibility within the actuator limits, and the DR chance constraint reduces tail risk.

papers.title_en: Constrained Federated Reinforcement Learning for Secure Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing
papers.authors: Zhiyu Wang, Muhammed F. Esgin, Mohammad Goudarzi
papers.evidence: 用拉格朗日松弛处理长期约束的约束MDP
papers.tldr: 车联网边缘计算中，依赖子任务卸载需兼顾低时延、高可靠与开放无线信道安全，联邦学习还受异构数据漂移影响。CRAFT将DAG任务卸载与资源分配建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，结合集中式critic、拉格朗日松弛和两层联邦聚合与近端正则。实验在墨尔本CBD真实网络与计算内核测试床上将加权成本最多降低42%，任务完成率约96%，安全开销仅6.4%。该工作为安全可靠的跨区域协同卸载提供了约束联邦强化学习方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers. Real vehicular workloads, however, consist of dependent subtasks with stringent reliability needs, while the cross-region collaborative learning used to adapt offloading policies must stay robust to heterogeneous data and secure over open wireless channels. We propose CRAFT, a Constrained Reinforcement-based Adaptive Federated Task Offloading framework that casts Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-structured offloading and resource allocation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. CRAFT couples centralized-critic policy learning with Lagrangian relaxation to explicitly regulate the long-term task-completion constraint, and uses two-tier federated aggregation with proximal regularization to jointly mitigate non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) drift and stabilize constraint adaptation. Confidentiality and integrity for federated parameter exchange are provided by post-quantum homomorphic encryption and lattice-based signatures with modest amortized overhead. On a Virtual Machine-based testbed over a realistic Melbourne Central Business District network with real computation kernels, CRAFT cuts weighted cost by up to 42% over state-of-the-art baselines, maintains a completion rate of around 96%, and adds 6.4% security overhead.

papers.title_en: Robot Motion Transition with Human Motion Prior
papers.authors: Taehyun Byun, Taemoon Jeong, Yoonbyung Chai, Woojin Wie, Insu Park, Kyungjae Lee, Sungjoon Choi
papers.evidence: 基于运动先验的人形运动生成与过渡
papers.tldr: 人形运动跟踪策略能复现多样动作，但将独立获取的动作连成连续序列仍很困难；简单插值忽略边界姿态的位置、朝向与时长，生成式先验也可能产生多余移动或转向。STAMP采用“机器人—人—机器人”流程，先在学习到的对齐模型中为后段动作排序候选位置、朝向和过渡时长，再用人类运动先验生成过渡，重定向回机器人训练跟踪策略。在Unitree G1与ROBOTIS K1上的实验和实机演示表明，该方法能把独立动作连接成长时程序列。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid motion-tracking policies can reproduce diverse behaviors, yet connecting independently acquired motions into a continuous sequence remains challenging. Interpolation connects boundary poses without considering whether their relative position, heading, and timing provide suitable conditions for a transition. A generative motion prior can produce richer motion, but poorly arranged boundaries may cause it to generate excessive locomotion, turning, or another unintended action. We present Spatio-Temporal Alignment with a Motion Prior (STAMP), a framework for connecting independently acquired humanoid motions through a Robot-to-Human-to-Robot process. STAMP uses human motion space to draw on rich motion priors and reuse transition knowledge across robot embodiments. Its key component is a learned alignment model that determines the boundary conditions for motion inbetweening. Given the two motions retargeted to a human rig, the alignment model ranks candidate positions, headings, and transition durations for the following motion. A human motion prior generates the transition under the selected alignment. The completed sequence is retargeted to the robot and used as a reference to train a motion-tracking policy. We evaluate the tracking success of the generated transitions on Unitree~G1 and~ROBOTIS K1. Physical robot demonstrations further show that STAMP connects independently acquired motions into long-horizon sequences. Project page: https://childtoy.github.io/STAMP-project

papers.title_en: Policy Evaluation and Policy Gradient for Continuous-Time Markov Regime-Switching Systems
papers.authors: Minghui Zhang, Xun Li, Xin Zhang
papers.evidence: 策略评估与策略梯度中的价值函数
papers.tldr: 针对连续时间马尔可夫机制切换系统的策略评估与策略梯度难题，论文同时处理扩散与机制跳变、耦合值函数及无模型学习规则构造。作者建立融合布朗与切换鞅的鞅刻画，扩展鞅损失与正交方法，并推导耦合策略梯度方程与轨迹型梯度表示。由此设计离线和在线actor-critic算法，给出收敛性与有限网格近似分析，并在机制切换LQ问题中验证。
papers.abstract_en: We study policy evaluation (PE) and policy gradient (PG) for continuous-time stochastic control with Markov regime-switching. The main challenges are the coexistence of diffusion and regime jumps, the coupling of regime-dependent value functions, and the construction of model-free learning rules from the coupled generators. We establish a martingale characterization of PE that incorporates both Brownian and switching martingales, and extend martingale loss and orthogonality methods to this setting. We further derive a coupled PG equation and a trajectory-based gradient representation that, under an action-independent switching generator, avoids explicit knowledge of the system coefficients and transition rates. These results lead to offline and online actor-critic algorithms. We also establish convergence and study the finite-grid approximation required for implementation. Numerical experiments for a regime-switching linear-quadratic problem illustrate the proposed methods.

papers.title_en: Memory before Goal: Role of Pre-History Memory for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Chenyuan Chen, Ran Ding, Lechen Zhang, Zewen He, Yoshihiko Nakamura
papers.evidence: 基于全身视觉语言动作策略的人形机器人移动操作
papers.tldr: 动态场景中的人形 loco-manipulation 具有非马尔可夫性，物体线索常消失或移出视野，而现有全身 VLA 策略只看当前帧。WholeBodyMem 用 SAM3 跟踪任务物体，并按物体事件因果筛选关键帧，以自适应预算保留动作前历史。动作专家通过交叉注意力读取这些帧及含外观、几何和时间的物体 token。该方法在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 上显著提升成功率，并优于无记忆与均匀记忆基线。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation in dynamic scenes is non-Markovian: cues vanish as objects change or are hidden, or leave the view as the robot turns and walks, yet whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies see only the present. We present WholeBodyMem, an object-guided perceptual memory that keeps the pre-history of object events seen before the robot acts on its goal. SAM3 tracks the task objects, and their events causally select key frames within an adaptive budget, which the action expert reads by cross-attention together with object tokens encoding appearance, geometry and time. We also contribute HuMeGo, a humanoid memory benchmark with six simulated and six real-world Unitree G1 tasks. Keeping the right frames rather than more frames, WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising its base policy's success from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and from 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot, while also improving the standard SIMPLE tasks (70.2% to 86.9%).

papers.title_en: SocialCoAct: Enabling and Benchmarking Egocentric Social Co-Action for VLM-Based Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Jiancong Ma, Kun Li, Jin Jiang, Shengcai Liao
papers.evidence: 人形机器人社交协同动作与动作序列生成
papers.tldr: 现有方法常将预生成语音直接映射为连续动作，缺乏复杂社交环境感知与高层语义动作规划。作者提出智能体中心框架SocialCoAct及SocialCoAct-Agent，将第一视角观察和对话历史转为语言回复与原子动作序列，并对齐动作与话语片段。还构建含423道多选题的SocialCoAct-Bench，覆盖长片段理解、说话人意图理解和协同动作规划，并支持在仿真和实体机器人上执行。最强VLM总体准确率77.54%，困难子集仅46.51%，扩展推理提升小模型但大幅降低吞吐。
papers.abstract_en: Enabling humanoid robots to participate effectively in social interactions is important for their integration into human-centered environments. Existing methods, however, typically map pre-generated speech directly to continuous motion trajectories but have limited awareness of complex social environments and lack explicit high-level semantic action planning. We introduce SocialCoAct, a unified agent-centered framework for VLM-based egocentric social co-action. We formulate egocentric social co-action as an end-to-end agent task and develop SocialCoAct-Agent, which transforms egocentric observations and dialogue history into verbal responses and atomic action sequences, aligns each action with its corresponding utterance span, and executes the resulting behaviors in MuJoCo and on a physical humanoid robot. To evaluate the VLM capabilities required by this task, we construct SocialCoAct-Bench from continuous egocentric recordings of natural multi-party interactions. The benchmark comprises 423 human-verified multiple-choice questions across three subtasks: Long Episode Understanding (LEU), Speaker Intention Understanding (SIU), and Coordinated Action Planning (CAP). Across a diverse set of closed-source and open-weight VLMs, including general and egocentric models, the highest overall accuracy is 77.54%, while accuracy on the hard subset reaches only 46.51%. Extended reasoning improves Qwen3-VL-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B by 19.62 and 17.02 percentage points, respectively, but reduces inference throughput by 53.6$\times$ and 20.2$\times$. Visual-input ablations further show that the benefits of visual context vary across models. SocialCoAct provides a foundation for developing and evaluating VLM-based humanoid agents that coordinate context-aware speech and action in complex social interactions. The codebase and benchmark will be made publicly available upon publication.

papers.title_en: Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models
papers.authors: Hui Yang, Wan Tian, Tao Ren, Zhongyi Li, Yijie Peng
papers.evidence: 带自适应裁剪的序列级策略优化
papers.tldr: 强化学习通过可验证奖励提升大模型数学与代码推理，但 GRPO 等 token 级方法的裁剪作用于单个 token 比率，奖励与优势却针对完整回答，存在单位错位；近期序列级方法虽对齐单位，仍采用固定裁剪带，尾部概率会随分数分布演化而改变。CSPO 利用近期训练统计自适应校准序列级裁剪边界，使裁剪带满足指定边际尾部预算并适应策略漂移。在 Qwen3-1.7B 系列上，CSPO 在困难数学推理基准和 ALFWorld 上优于 GSPO，且裁剪端点随训练动态调整。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning improves the reasoning capability of large language models through verifiable rewards for mathematical and coding tasks. In token-level methods such as GRPO, clipping acts on individual token ratios while the reward and advantage apply to a complete response. Recent sequence-level methods align these units but still use fixed clipping bands, whose tail probabilities change as the score distribution evolves. We propose Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization (CSPO), which adaptively calibrates sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics. The resulting band targets a specified marginal tail budget and adapts to policy drift; calibration conditional on response length requires additional assumptions. We bound the probability that a fresh score falls outside the band by the target miscoverage level plus explicit CDF discrepancy and drift terms. Under additional moment conditions, this bound also controls the objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate. Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series show improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints that adapt during training.

papers.title_en: SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Shenli Zheng, Zhou Fang, Yuan Du, Yijiang Liu, Li Du
papers.evidence: 结合强化学习恢复的高效结构化剪枝
papers.tldr: 针对VLA模型在机器人端侧算力受限、激进压缩又会损害操作性能的问题，SPAR通过剪枝感知调优同时裁剪LLM主干的隐藏层与FFN中间维度，并用强化学习恢复策略表现。在π0.5上，语言主干从2.34B降至0.09B，整体模型从3.37B降至1.12B，分别去除约96%和67%参数。LIBERO四套任务平均成功率由84.55%提升至93.45%，推理加速1.98倍。结果表明中间维度存在显著冗余，剪枝后RL可恢复紧凑策略的操控能力。
papers.abstract_en: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $π_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.

papers.title_en: EmbodyHOI: Embodiment-Aware Generation of Hand-Object Interactions for Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Chaitanya Chawla, Kartik Sharma, Ananya Bal, Laszlo A. Jeni, Guanya Shi
papers.evidence: 以机器人具身可达性约束人形机器人动作生成
papers.tldr: 文本条件手物交互生成能提供丰富示范，但动作处于人手MANO空间，重定向到人形机器人后容易丢失接触并损害策略学习。EmbodyHOI在冻结的流匹配HOI采样循环中嵌入可微分逆运动学求解器，把目标机器人可达性梯度回传，并联合优化机器人相对物体的位置。在ARCTIC上，腕部重定向误差从8.9厘米降至0.6厘米，G1与H1-2任务成功率分别从68%升至79%、从62%升至76%。该方法无需重训练即可跨人形本体迁移，表明生成时施加本体约束优于事后重定向与best-of-N筛选。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid dexterous manipulation needs reference motions that are both semantically rich and kinematically feasible for the target robot. Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generators supply diverse, language-specified demonstrations, but they synthesize motion in human (MANO) space. The embodiment gap is therefore deferred to post-hoc retargeting, where trajectories deployed on the robot can fail to maintain contact with objects and also degrade policy learning. Our key idea is that robot reachability should constrain the interaction trajectories while they are being generated. We present EmbodyHOI, which runs a differentiable inverse-kinematics (IK) solver for a specific humanoid embodiment inside the sampling loop of a frozen flow-matching HOI trajectory generator. We feed back gradients from the embodiment-aware IK solver into the HOI sampler and jointly optimize the position of the humanoid with respect to the object. Because guidance acts only at inference, one HOI trajectory generator trained on human hand poses transfers across humanoid embodiments without retraining. On ARCTIC trajectories with two contrasting humanoids (Unitree G1 and H1-2), our proposed guidance-based method cuts the retargeted wrist error from 8.9 cm to 0.6 cm while leaving text-to-HOI generation quality intact, and raises task success from 68% to 79% on 50 random G1 tasks and from 62% to 76% on a four-task H1-2 suite. Critically, cheaper alternatives for bridging the embodiment gap fail to beat EmbodyHOI. Post-hoc wrist refinement and compute-matched best-of-N selection both reach lower IK energy than our guidance yet train worse policies. For simulation results, see our website: https://embodyhoi.github.io/

papers.title_en: VPFlow: Value-Predictive Planning with Imperfect World Models for Offline Goal Reaching
papers.evidence: 模型强化学习中的值预测规划与值回归
papers.tldr: 现有离线目标条件强化学习常假设规划需要准确状态预测，但本文发现价值预测更关键。VPFlow仅以闭式蒙特卡洛回报监督潜世界模型，让其预测目标达成价值，并结合一步流策略在噪声空间进化搜索。在30个状态和像素OGBench数据集上，成功率分别至少超无模型基线30.3和10.1个百分点，并胜过多个潜规划器。结果表明，在离线规划中，规划导向的价值表征比精确状态预测更重要。
papers.abstract_en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning enables skill acquisition by reaching any goal from any state without dense rewards. Model-based methods allow for planning by scaling test-time compute to solve complex tasks. Combining both holds appealing promise for pre-training on suboptimal demonstrations and zero-shot adaptation via goal specification and planning. Yet existing methods assume effective planning requires accurate next-state prediction in pixel or latent space. In this work, we show that value prediction is more useful for planning, whereas accurate state prediction is often unnecessary. Our key insight is that offline goal reaching naturally admits a closed-form Monte Carlo return, enabling value regression to replace temporal-difference bootstrapping. We use this return as the sole supervision for latent world models: imagined latents are trained to predict goal-reaching value rather than match future states, implicitly preventing representation collapse. These planning-oriented representations let imperfect world models imagine on the level sets of value field beyond dataset transitions. We then present VPFlow, a value-predictive planner that pairs the world models with a one-step flow policy and plans in its noise space via evolutionary search. It enables policy improvement with imagined generalized advantage and reduces out-of-distribution queries common in action-space planning. On 30 state and pixel OGBench datasets, VPFlow surpasses model-free baselines by at least 30.3 and 10.1 percentage points in success rate, respectively, and outperforms latent planners LeWorldModel, PLDM, and TD-MPC2. It achieves this despite a latent prediction error orders of magnitude larger than with state prediction, while minimizing this error lowers success rate. This demonstrates that value-predictive representations, not exact state prediction, are what offline planning requires.

papers.title_en: AWLS: Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering for One-Step Generative Robotic Manipulation Policies
papers.authors: Jiahong Tang, Jiaju He, Zhiyuan Yang, Ruyang Han, Haiyue Zhu
papers.evidence: 利用离线强化学习价值估计引导生成式操作策略
papers.tldr: 机器人操作演示常混有犹豫、绕路或低效片段，扩散/流策略虽能建模多模态数据，但标准行为克隆会对所有动作赋予相同似然，易复现次优模式。AWLS 对冻结的单步生成策略做离线后训练，学习观测条件化的潜噪声残差修正器，并以优势加权动作重建目标训练；优势值脱离梯度、仅作监督权重，避免评论家梯度更新和先验漂移。仿真与真实任务显示，AWLS 在干净和混合质量演示上均优于冻结基策略，同时保持单步推理并限制行为先验漂移。
papers.abstract_en: Human-collected real-world robotic manipulation demonstrations often contain mixed-quality trajectories, including hesitant, indirect, or inefficient action segments. While diffusion- and flow-based policies can model such multimodal data, standard behavior cloning (BC) assigns equal likelihood to all demonstrated actions and may therefore reproduce suboptimal modes. Offline RL value estimates offer a natural signal for biasing policies toward higher-value behavioral modes, but directly fine-tuning the generative policy or using critic gradients for policy steering can amplify critic errors and induce prior drift. We propose Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering (AWLS), an offline post-training method for improving frozen one-step generative manipulation policies without updating their decoders. AWLS learns a residual noise shaper, an observation-conditioned residual correction to the policy's latent noise, and trains it with an advantage-weighted action reconstruction objective. The advantages are detached, scale-normalized, and used only as supervised weights on demonstrated actions, avoiding critic-gradient policy updates while preserving fast single-step inference. We further introduce a rollout-free decoder-sensitivity criterion for selecting pretrained checkpoints that remain responsive to latent-noise perturbations. Experiments on simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks with clean and mixed-quality demonstrations show that AWLS improves over the frozen base policy while limiting drift from the pretrained behavior prior. Project page: https://awls-corl2026.github.io/

papers.title_en: State-Dependent Objective Coordination for End-to-End Balance and Navigation
papers.authors: Xuhao Huang, Xitao Xu, Yuxin Zheng, Yunfan Ren, Zheng Gong
papers.evidence: 用于平衡与导航运动控制的端到端强化学习策略
papers.tldr: 两轮倒立摆机器人端到端导航中，避障前进与姿态稳定存在强状态相关冲突，传统级联模块还带来延迟与开销。作者提出俯仰角条件化的状态相关目标协调系数β(s)，在PPO训练中动态权衡平衡与导航，无需额外PID/LQR或控制层级。仿真与零样本实机表明，固定障碍图和高密度随机障碍图成功率分别达98%和95%，姿态偏差小且仅靠机载观测避障。该工作为不稳定平台的集成导航控制提供了轻量方案。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional robotic navigation systems separate mapping, planning, and low-level control through cascaded modules, introducing computational overhead and accumulated latency. End-to-end reinforcement learning offers a compact unified policy that maps onboard observations directly to control actions. However, on inherently unstable platforms such as two-wheeled inverted-pendulum robots, navigation progress and obstacle avoidance can conflict with attitude stabilization in a strongly state-dependent manner. We propose a lightweight state-dependent objective coordination method for integrated navigation and control. A pitch-conditioned scalarization coefficient $β(s)\in[0,1]$ adjusts the relative contributions of balance stabilization and navigation objectives during training, without extra control hierarchies or auxiliary attitude-stabilization controllers, such as proportional-integral-derivative (PID) or linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) controllers. To support zero-shot deployment, simulation training models execution delay, action hold, asynchronous and noisy observations, and dynamics uncertainty. Gradient analysis reveals persistent directional interference and state-dependent variation in the objectives' relative scales. Comparisons with alternative reward-weighting, constraint, training, and control-structure strategies show that PPO+$β(s)$, where PPO denotes proximal policy optimization, achieves 98% and 95% success rates with small attitude excursions on the fixed obstacle map and the randomly generated high-obstacle-density map, respectively. Zero-shot hardware experiments further demonstrate bounded attitude behavior and consistent obstacle avoidance using only onboard observations. Training and evaluation code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

papers.title_en: Flat-RLVR: Sharpness-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Reasoning Capacity in LLMs
papers.authors: Yeonbum Kim, Hyun Kyu Lee, Sung Whan Yoon
papers.evidence: 结合可验证奖励的锐度感知策略优化
papers.tldr: RLVR（如GRPO）能提升大模型推理，但会导致策略分布过度尖锐，稀有正确轨迹被抑制、采样多样性下降。Flat-RLVR在LLM后训练中用锐度感知最小化寻找平坦奖励区域，并与GRPO变体结合。理论上将其与降低分布尖锐化关联，实验显示在保持单次尝试准确率的同时提升样本多样性。该方法改善了采样效率与推理能力之间的权衡，为RLVR后训练提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces \textit{distribution sharpening}, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. Our method, called \texttt{Flat}-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.

papers.title_en: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Likui Zhang, Zhe Zhu, Zhihao Zhan, Yibo Bai, Hanlin Wang, Dongwei Li, Bin Wang, Tianle Zhang, Xiaodan Liang, Liang Lin
papers.evidence: 利用语义感知门控进行信用分配的强化学习策略优化
papers.tldr: VLA策略仅靠模仿学习难以掌握长时程机器人操作，现有VLA-RL又受轨迹级稀疏奖励导致延迟且有偏的信用分配困扰。AtomicRL作为RL后训练框架，用语义感知门控的SAPO阻断失败原子子任务的TD残差跨边界传播，并用BATE按子任务掌握度协调采样与局部探索。在LIBERO-LONG上较PPO提升3.6%和4.0%，CALVIN ABC-D全任务最高提升9.5%，结合Real2Sim2Real真实任务平均提升21.3%。它提升了长时程VLA策略的学习效率与操作性能。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.
